White Russian Adult Milkshake
By: Ben Myhre
Published: Thursday, October 25, 2018 - 5:53pm

Ingredients




500 grams Vanilla Ice Cream (approximately 6 large scoops)
3 Ounces Vodka
3 Ounces Kahlua
1/4 cup milk
Whipped Cream
Cherry

Preparation

1 Measure out the Ice cream and place in refrigerator for 3o minutes to soften. 2 Add milk, Kahlua, and vodka to the blender. 3 Add ice cream to the blender 4 Mix on low setting until it reaches a shake-like consistency 5 Pour into shake glasses, top with whipped cream and cherry 6 serve!

About

The Dude Abides, particularly if you give him ice cream. This adult boozy milkshake pays homage to the White Russian cocktail and gives tasty dessert flavors! I feel like the flavors of a White Russian lend themselves really well to a dessert. Coffee Liqueur (or Kahlua) really is a very sweet drink and the cream that goes into a White Russian adds a rich dessert feel to it. The cream easily translates to ice cream, since cream is the primary ingredient. The other flavors make this such a tasty adult treat. So, why make this White Russian Adult Milkshake? Because it is damn tasty and I can do want.
